cards.title: Play School Returns: Quality TV for Toddlers
cards.body: The beloved children's show is back, offering parents relief from frantic programs designed to grab attention like smartphones do. It's a welcome antidote for parents of young children seeking quality viewing options.

cards.title: Working Parents Face School Holiday Logistics Nightmare
cards.body: Managing childcare around the school day creates endless logistical challenges for working parents. The gap between school hours and work schedules leaves many parents juggling competing demands.

cards.title: Talking to Kids About Politics
cards.body: With midterms approaching, parents should consider whether and how to discuss politics with their children. Now is a good time to think through age-appropriate conversations about current events.

cards.title: Gaslighting in Parent-Child Relationships
cards.body: Recent research examines gaslighting between parents and children and its link to depression in youth. The study explores whether self-blame explains the connection between parental gaslighting and depressive symptoms.

cards.title: Building Accountability Without Creating Monsters
cards.body: Parents often confuse sympathy with empathy, preventing children from developing accountability and resilience. Curating proper accountability helps children become successful and responsible.

cards.title: Why Gen Z Won't Answer Phone Calls
cards.body: Young people experience phone calls differently than older generations, often finding them anxiety-inducing. Understanding Gen Z's perspective on calls can help parents find compromises in communication.

cards.title: When Parents Disagree: What to Tell Kids
cards.body: Children sense tension between parents and often imagine worst-case scenarios. It's better to tell them the truth, even hard truths, than leave them to worry.

cards.title: Why You Feel Emotions Your Family Won't
cards.body: Sometimes one family member expresses emotions no one else is willing to name. What looks like overreacting may actually be channeling everyone's unspoken feelings.
